information: Ver la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AtipanakuyLima2024#49925-registro-registration) para obtener información detallada. Además, todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) Debido a cuestiones de aforo, los participantes deben evitar asistir con invitados. See the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AtipanakuyLima2024#49925-registro-registration) tab for detailed information. Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) Due to capacity limitations, participants should avoid attending with guests. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4NzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--4be485bd2a1912b73e7b3a9bb19ee81de2079457/aaaaaaaaa.png)
